build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO(2) convolution layer for all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial gating
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an SO(2) convolution block using block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization
build_SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock: build a first SO(2) convolution layer with radial MLP and extra m0 gating channels
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer for all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial function
convert_SO2_Convolution_to_block: convert an existing SO2_Convolution to a block-diagonal GEMM variant for better performance
